notes.title: Piece of advice for players new and old. (IMPORTANT!!!!)
notes.content:
Hey it's me again.
This game sucks, plain and simple, alright? It's straight up horrendous, abominable even. Play at your own peril.
A big reason for that is that it's been created using this ancient game engine called 3D Rad, which has a ton of limitations and quirks. Of course someone who knows what he's doing could make a decent game out of it, but this was one of the first games i've ever made and i had zero skills and self awareness.

If you really have to play a game of mine, pick something more recent, such as 30 Days to be the Best or Mariuccha, Alchemy Queen, which i think i already spammed. They also suck but they don't crash if you press Escape.
Links:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1908490/30_Days_to_be_the_Best__Ultimate_Edition/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542010/Mariuccha_Alchemy_Queen/

notes.title: Change price, bug fixes and much more!
notes.content:
PASKA BATTLE STYLE! has reached its first month of life, and well... it was a month. It's a game i hold dear in my heart, and i want people to see what it really can do, so i'm making the price a lot more affordable. On top of that, for those who were skeptical at first, i have released a demo with one level from the game so that you can make up your mind. 
Plus lots and lots of small bugs fixes.
Hoping for a good 2019, financially speaking. But you shouldn't care about that.
